verdict: A strong ROAS week, but revenue is clustering on a handful of days.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.54 for every $1 spent — and purchases jumped 350% and ROAS 416% compared to the prior week. That spike is real, but it's concentrated: three days accounted for the bulk of revenue, while 19 of the 28 days recorded zero sales. The goal now is building a steadier daily purchase rate rather than relying on clustered bursts, and the team is working to extend what's working in the top-performing campaign into more consistent daily coverage. Expect continued refinement of the ad strategy ahead of the August 31 funnel test close, after which the buying pattern should become easier to read.

watch_item.issue: Revenue is arriving in clusters — 19 of the last 28 days showed zero purchases, meaning the strong weekly numbers rest on a thin daily foundation. Google Business Profile engagement also flatlined over the last three days of the period, which is worth watching alongside the ecom results.
watch_item.fix: The team is working to broaden daily purchase consistency through the current Meta campaigns, and the Live-Cooking content shoot — a key asset for organic and ad creative — is being rescheduled to get the video pipeline moving again.
